title: Total RNA Extraction from Adherent Mammalian Cancer Cells using the Zymo Quick-RNA Miniprep Kit
author: Boluwatife OLU OLU Afolabi

steps.title: Prepare Cell Lysate
steps.instruction: Aspirate culture medium and lyse adherent cells in the multi-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate culture medium from the well using a vacuum suction system, keeping the cell monolayer intact.
Immediately add 500 µL of RNA Lysis Buffer directly to the cell monolayer in each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 2 to 10 minutes.

steps.title: Homogenize and Collect Lysate
steps.instruction: Mechanically disrupt cells and transfer the lysate to a tube.

substeps.instruction: Scrape the surface of the well with a 1000 µL micropipette tip to disrupt cells.
Pipette the lysate up and down several times to homogenize.
Transfer the entire volume of the lysate into a labeled RNase-free microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Initial RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Pass the lysate through a Zymo-Spin IIICG Column.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the homogenized lysate into a Zymo-Spin IIICG Column (yellow) pre-seated in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: Secondary RNA Binding
steps.instruction: Bind RNA from the flow-through using ethanol and a Zymo-Spin IICR Column.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume (1:1 ratio) of 100% ethanol to the retained flow-through (e.g., 500 µL ethanol for 500 µL flow-through).
Mix thoroughly by pipetting or vortexing.
Transfer the entire mixture into a Zymo-Spin IICR Column (green) pre-seated in a collection tube.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 30 seconds.

steps.title: First Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the green column to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL of RNA Wash Buffer to the green column.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.

steps.title: On-Column DNase Digestion
steps.instruction: Remove DNA from the bound RNA using DNase I.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a master mix in a separate clean tube by combining 75 µL of DNA Digestion Buffer and 5 µL of DNase I enzyme per sample; mix gently by flicking.
Carefully apply the entire 80 µL of the DNase I master mix directly onto the column matrix.
Incubate the column at room temperature for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Post-Digestion Wash
steps.instruction: Wash the column to remove DNase and buffers.

substeps.instruction: Add 400 µL of RNA Prep Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.
Add 700 µL of RNA Wash Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 30 seconds and discard the flow-through.
Add another 400 µL of RNA Wash Buffer to the column.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 1 minute to remove residual wash buffer.

steps.title: Column Drying
steps.instruction: Ensure the column is completely dry before elution.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the green column to a new collection tube.
Centrifuge at top speed (≥13,000 x g) for 15 seconds.

steps.title: RNA Elution
steps.instruction: Elute the purified RNA into a clean tube.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the Zymo-Spin IICR Column (green) into a new, labeled 1.5 mL RNase/DNase-free microcentrifuge tube.
Add 100 µL of DNase/RNase-Free Water directly to the column matrix.
Incubate for 1 minute at room temperature.
Centrifuge at 13,000 x g for 30 seconds to elute the RNA.
